items.description: Air conditioning unit - living room (surge damaged, replaced like-for-like)
items.rationale: Covered under 2.3.3 (overvoltage caused by lightning) as a fixed, permanently wired technical installation forming part of the building. The unit is not within 5m of a cooking appliance, so the exclusion in 2.3.10(c) does not apply. Indemnity is for a like-for-like replacement (7.1.9), capped at the ordinary market price for such a unit, including VAT.

items.description: Air conditioning unit - kitchen (wall-mounted a couple of metres from the hob)
items.rationale: Although surge damage is generally covered under 2.3.3, exclusion 2.3.10(c) applies: climate-control equipment within 5m of a cooking appliance is excluded unless a kitchen climate endorsement is present (none here). Therefore, this unit is not indemnified.

Installation of a covered replacement is indemnified as part of the necessary repair/replacement cost (7.1.9(c)), since the living-room unit is covered. Estimate based on typical installation charges for fixed AC units.
Ancillary charges (installation) are only indemnified if the principal item is covered (7.1.11). As the kitchen unit is excluded by 2.3.10(c), installation is also excluded.

items.description: Floor console (equivalent stand for the living-room unit)
items.rationale: The floor console is a necessary support for the covered living-room unit (7.1.9(b)), and the old one was damaged and could not be reused. Indemnified at the ordinary market price for a replacement stand.

Freight is an ancillary charge (1.3, 7.1.9(e), 7.1.11) and is indemnified only for the covered principal item(s). Here, only the living-room unit is covered, so only the proportion of shipping attributable to that unit is indemnified (apportioned 50%).
